title: Aerial View Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutAerial View ~ 81 Cypress Hill Road~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 5-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Aerial View is a luxurious, 4,630sf home (3,848 interior sf) located next to Seaside, in Old Seagrove. With 5 bedrooms/4 full baths/2 half baths, Aerial View will sleep up to 14 guests and offers an elevator, 10'x23' private heated pool (heating fee applies), 3 living areas, 3rd Floor views of the Gulf and Seaside rooftops, a 5-minute stroll to the neighborhood beach access and a 90-second walk into Seaside. PLEASE NOTE: There is NO spa/hot tub feature on the pool; this is simply an extension of the pool that can only be heated if you have paid to have the pool heated. Living room fireplace is decorative only (not for guest use). On-street parking is not allowed; please note parking spaces below and plan accordingly. Ground Level: Open floor plan, 14' ceilings, powder room, dining table for 8, bar seating for 4, 1 bedroom, 1 bath, kitchen, butler's kitchen/pantry. #1 En-suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower Second Level: Kid's den (Queen sleeper), 3 bedrooms, 2 powder rooms, shared shower room, 1 full bath, laundry room. #2 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, separate tub, double vanity #3 Family Bedroom has a King bed, Twin sleeper, en-suite powder room #4 Family Bedroom has a King bed, Twin sleeper, en-suite powder room Shared walk-in Shower between #3 and #4 powder rooms Third Level: Media room, wet bar, powder room, 1 bedroom, 1 bath, large deck #5 En-Suite Bedroom (Master) has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 7 Flat Screen TVs, 3 Blu-Ray /DVD players, board games, books Distinctive Features Gulf and Seaside rooftop views Private heated pool (heating fee applies - no spa/hot tub) Elevator Subzero, Wolf, Miele appliances 3 living rooms 90-second walk into Seaside Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed; please plan accordingly) 5 King beds, Queen sleeper, 2 Twin sleepers 4 full bathrooms, 4 powder rooms, shared shower room, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, outdoor charcoal and gas grills w/ grill utensils, outdoor deck, deck furniture, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, butler's kitchen/pantry, 2 coffee makers, gas range, warming drawer, wine cooler, 2 ice machines, refrigerator with ice dispenser, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (90-seconds) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
